title: Pool of Pumpkins
blurb: Annual floating pumpkin patch: swim in the pool, pick a pumpkin to take home, plus arts & crafts and carnival games. No entrance fee; $13 wristband to take home a pumpkin.

title: Veterans Day Parade
blurb: Elk Grove's annual Veterans Day Parade: Reading of the Names ceremony at 10 am, parade at 11:11 am, then a community picnic open to the public.
